title: Silent Surge Staging Canvas & Rollback Scenarios (May 2028)
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight staging + canary approach we want to pilot for low-risk infra changes and model variant swaps: "silent surge" — route production traffic into a shadowed path that can be toggled live with a fast rollback ladder. Goal is <1% production disruption while exercising the full stack and measuring end-to-end perf/quality.

Audience:
- Release engineers (owners)
- SRE on-call (watch)
- Release approver (product/pm)
- Solutions engineers for customer-impacted features

Scope:
- Applies to model variant swaps, runtime kernel updates, batching config changes, and non-user-visible infra opt-ins. Not for schema migrations or front-end feature flags.

Quick summary (one-liner):
Kick a silent-surge from staging -> canary-shadow -> incremental ramp (shadow-to-live toggle available) -> post-checks -> full rollout. If any signal breaches, rollback to previous route and open escalation.

Calendar (week of May 6 2028):
- Mon 05/06: Preflight window 09:00-11:00 PT — dry-run on taxi cluster, update canary routing policies
- Tue 05/07: Staging soak 06:00-18:00 PT — 24h smoke & perf, collect baseline traces
- Wed 05/08: Canary shadow start 07:00 PT — route 5% shadow traffic for 3h (silent metrics only)
- Wed 05/08: Canary review 10:00 PT — telemetry review + brief (15m)
- Wed 05/08: Ramp plan (conditional): 5% -> 15% -> 33% shadow over 24h if no regressions
- Thu 05/09: Optional live toggle dry-run (operator simulated traffic toggle)
- Fri 05/10: Full rollout approval window 10:00-14:00 PT (if all green)

Preflight checklist (must be green before any traffic is moved):
- [ ] PRs merged: runtime + router + infra templates (verify GH actions passing)
- [ ] Release branch built and artifacts hashed (SHA in release notes)
- [ ] KMS access tested for new keys (if any)
- [ ] Rollout config uploaded to ops-store and versioned
- [ ] Smoke harness: run 3 smoke scenarios from staging (gen/embeddings/rerank)
- [ ] Telemetry hooks verified (span ids, trace sampling set to 100% for canary window)
- [ ] Incident channel created: #release-surge with pinned runbook
- [ ] Pager rotations notified (SRE lead + release eng in rotation)
- [ ] Postgres migrations none (confirm) or migration plan approved

Staging soak checklist:
- [ ] Warm caches by replaying last 2h token streams (prefix cache hit target > 85%)
- [ ] Verify batching distribution matches expected percentiles (P50/P95/P99)
- [ ] Perf baseline: median latency <= baseline + 5ms, p99 <= baseline + 50ms
- [ ] Memory/VRAM checks: no native OOM events during 30m soak
- [ ] Log level set to INFO (debug off) except for canary trace sampling

Canary / Silent-Surge steps (operator flow):
1) Deploy artifacts to canary pool (tag: canary-2028-05-08)
2) Start shadow routing: route 5% of incoming requests to new path as shadow copy (no user response)
3) Confirm telemetry ingest: metric names exist and tags contain canary=2028-05-08
4) Run synthetic quality evals for 5 example prompts (automated harness)
5) 3h hold; quick review call at 90m if anomalies reported
6) Conditional ramp to 15% shadow for next 9h -> 33% overnight if green
7) If all clean after 24h, open approval for live toggle (partial live can be toggled to 5% live)

Immediate rollback triggers (fast path):
- p95 latency increase > 2x baseline for > 10 minutes
- error rate (5xx) > 0.5% absolute increase for > 5 minutes
- quality regression: automated eval score drop > 6 points on primary prompt set
- OOMs / infra panics in canary pool
- Any customer-reported Sev1 in the first 30m after live toggle

Rollback ladder (operator commands and responsibilities):
- Fast rollback (operator): toggle router -> previous-version route (1 minute) -> notify #release-surge
- If toggle fails: run emergency-sentinel (script sentry/bridge -> drain new pool) and escalate to SRE lead
- Post-rollback: capture heap traces, upload artifact hashes to incident ticket, start RCA board

Observability & signals (what to look at):
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 for text-gen endpoints, per-model shard
- Error surface: 4xx/5xx, backend error codes, retried requests
- Telemetry: trace completion times, model KV cache hit ratio, batching size distribution
- Cost: per-token exec time (rough gauge) to detect runaway costs when quantization changes
- Quality: prompt-set eval delta (automated suite) + small human spot-check list (3 reviewers)

Smoke tests (run automatically and manually):
- baseline-gen: generate 5 short completions and check token correctness heuristics
- long-seq: 1k token generation stress to validate KV cache and streaming
- embedding-embedding: produce 128-dim and compare norm variance
- tool-call: simulated tool-calling flow (function call JSON)

Release notes (draft snippet):
- Version: canary-2028-05-08 (SHA: abc123def)
- Changes: kernel selection fallback improved, batching heuristics refined, minor model weight quantization tune
- Impact: Reduced p50 latency for long-context workloads by ~4ms in internal staging tests.
- Known issues: There is a small chance of transient 500s on model shard X during first 10m after warmup; we will monitor closely.

Operator runbook (short):
- Start: ./ops/route-canary --tag canary-2028-05-08 --shadow 5
- Check: ./ops/check-telemetry --since now-3h --filter canary=canary-2028-05-08
- Toggle live: ./ops/switch-live --tag canary-2028-05-08 --percent 5 (requires approval scope)
- Rollback: ./ops/switch-live --tag stable --force (fast path)

Post-rollout actions (if rollout succeeds):
- [ ] 24h watch: daily check-ins at 3h, 8h, 24h windows
- [ ] Merge canary tag into release main and annotate changelog
- [ ] Schedule a short 1-hour retro with SRE + release eng within 48h
- [ ] Capture quality evaluation artifacts and store in release vault

Open questions / TODOs:
- Decide SLO guard thresholds for "silent-surge" (SRE: set numeric guard rails).
- Confirm legal/compliance signoff for full live toggles for private deployment customers.
- Add automated rollback smoke that runs every ramp step (script currently TODO).

Notes to self (Maya):
- Keep shadow windows short at first; prefer more frequent small surges rather than a big one.
- Ask Priya to add the test prompt set for convo drift evaluation (PR pending).
- We should add an emergency dry-run checklist for weekends (rotation cover differs).

Meeting snippets (for release brief):
- "If the automated eval dips more than 6 points we immediately roll back to stable and open Sev2 investigations." — SRE note
- "We want 100% trace sampling for first 2h of canary to get KV/cache visibility." — Perf lead

Appendix: quick reference commands (operator):
- List canary pools: ./ops/list-pools | grep canary
- Drain pool: ./ops/drain --pool canary-2028-05-08
- Snapshot logs: ./ops/snapshot-logs --since 30m --tag canary-2028-05-08 > /tmp/canary-logs.tgz

End of draft.

(Informal / scratchpad style — this will be cleaned into a formal runbook once pilot validated)
